parameters.query:
SELECT
    r.id AS reel_id,
    r.shortcode,
    r.object_key,
    r.sha256,
    r.file_size_bytes,
    $2::TEXT AS pipeline_version,
    $3::TEXT AS contract_version,
    $4::TEXT AS language_hint,
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM app.reel_enrichments AS enrichment
        WHERE enrichment.reel_id = r.id
          AND enrichment.source_object_key = r.object_key
          AND enrichment.source_sha256 = r.sha256
          AND enrichment.pipeline_version = $2::TEXT
    ) AS has_applicable_result
FROM app.reels AS r
WHERE r.id = $1::BIGINT
  AND r.download_status = 'downloaded'
  AND r.object_key IS NOT NULL
  AND r.object_key <> ''
  AND r.sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  AND r.file_size_bytes > 0;

WITH queued_reel AS (
    UPDATE app.reels AS reel
    SET
        transcription_status = 'queued',
        transcription_attempt_id = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE reel.id = $1::BIGINT
      AND reel.download_status = 'downloaded'
      AND reel.transcription_status IN ('not_requested', 'failed')
      AND reel.transcription_attempt_id IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM app.reel_enrichments AS enrichment
          WHERE enrichment.reel_id = reel.id
            AND enrichment.source_object_key = reel.object_key
            AND enrichment.source_sha256 = reel.sha256
            AND enrichment.pipeline_version = $2::TEXT
      )
    RETURNING
        reel.id AS reel_id,
        reel.shortcode,
        reel.object_key,
        reel.sha256,
        reel.file_size_bytes
)
SELECT
    queued_reel.*,
    $2::TEXT AS pipeline_version,
    $3::TEXT AS contract_version,
    $4::TEXT AS language_hint,
    $5::UUID AS retry_of_attempt_id
FROM queued_reel;

WITH consumer_lock AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* MGB030_TRANSCRIPTION_CLAIM_LOCK_KEY = 308030 */
    SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(308030::BIGINT) AS acquired
), candidate AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        reel.id AS reel_id,
        reel.shortcode,
        reel.object_key,
        reel.sha256,
        reel.file_size_bytes
    FROM app.reels AS reel
    CROSS JOIN consumer_lock
    WHERE consumer_lock.acquired
      AND ($3::BIGINT IS NULL OR reel.id = $3::BIGINT)
      AND reel.download_status = 'downloaded'
      AND reel.transcription_status = 'queued'
      AND reel.transcription_attempt_id IS NULL
      AND reel.object_key IS NOT NULL
      AND reel.object_key <> ''
      AND reel.sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      AND reel.file_size_bytes > 0
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM app.reels AS processing_reel
          WHERE processing_reel.transcription_status = 'processing'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM app.reel_enrichments AS enrichment
          WHERE enrichment.reel_id = reel.id
            AND enrichment.source_object_key = reel.object_key
            AND enrichment.source_sha256 = reel.sha256
            AND enrichment.pipeline_version = $2::TEXT
      )
    ORDER BY reel.updated_at ASC, reel.id ASC
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 1
), activated_reel AS (
    UPDATE app.reels AS reel
    SET
        transcription_status = 'processing',
        transcription_attempt_id = $1::UUID,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM candidate
    WHERE reel.id = candidate.reel_id
      AND transcription_status = 'queued'
      AND reel.transcription_attempt_id IS NULL
    RETURNING
        reel.id AS reel_id,
        candidate.shortcode,
        candidate.object_key AS source_object_key,
        candidate.sha256 AS expected_sha256,
        candidate.file_size_bytes AS expected_size_bytes
), created_attempt AS (
    INSERT INTO app.reel_enrichment_attempts (
        attempt_id, reel_id, source_object_key, expected_sha256,
        expected_size_bytes, pipeline_version, contract_version, language_hint,
        retry_of_attempt_id, status, started_at
    )
    SELECT
        $1::UUID,
        activated_reel.reel_id,
        activated_reel.source_object_key,
        activated_reel.expected_sha256,
        activated_reel.expected_size_bytes,
        $2::TEXT,
        $4::TEXT,
        $5::TEXT,
        NULL::UUID,
        'processing',
        NOW()
    FROM activated_reel
    /*
    TC2-D removed normal-claim implicit retry selection:
    FROM app.reel_enrichment_attempts AS previous_attempt
    previous_attempt.status = 'failed'
    previous_attempt.reel_id = activated_reel.reel_id
    previous_attempt.source_object_key = activated_reel.source_object_key
    previous_attempt.expected_sha256 = activated_reel.expected_sha256
    previous_attempt.pipeline_version = $2::TEXT
    ORDER BY previous_attempt.finished_at DESC NULLS LAST
    retry_of_attempt_id is NULL::UUID for normal claims.
    */
    RETURNING
        attempt_id, reel_id, source_object_key, expected_sha256,
        expected_size_bytes, pipeline_version, contract_version, language_hint, retry_of_attempt_id
)
SELECT created_attempt.*, activated_reel.shortcode
FROM created_attempt
JOIN activated_reel ON activated_reel.reel_id = created_attempt.reel_id;

WITH completed_attempt AS (
    UPDATE app.reel_enrichment_attempts
    SET
        status = 'completed',
        finished_at = NOW(),
        enricher_version = $2,
        stt_provider = $3,
        stt_model = $4,
        provider_request_id = $5
    WHERE attempt_id = $1::UUID
      AND status = 'processing'
    RETURNING attempt_id
), persisted_result AS (
    INSERT INTO app.reel_enrichments (
        reel_id, source_attempt_id, source_object_key, source_sha256,
        source_size_bytes, pipeline_version, completed_at,
        container_format, media_duration_seconds, video_codec, video_width, video_height,
        audio_present, audio_codec, audio_sample_rate_hz, audio_channels, audio_duration_seconds,
        transcription_audio_format, transcription_audio_sample_rate_hz,
        transcription_audio_channels, transcription_audio_duration_seconds,
        outcome, transcript_text, transcript_language
    )
    SELECT
        $6::BIGINT, completed_attempt.attempt_id, $7, $8,
        $9::BIGINT, $10, $11::TIMESTAMPTZ,
        $12, $13::NUMERIC, $14, $15::INTEGER, $16::INTEGER,
        $17::BOOLEAN, $18, $19::INTEGER, $20::INTEGER, $21::NUMERIC,
        $22, $23::INTEGER, $24::INTEGER, $25::NUMERIC,
        $26, $27, $28
    FROM completed_attempt
    RETURNING id, source_attempt_id, outcome
)
UPDATE app.reels
SET
    transcription_status = 'completed',
    transcription_attempt_id = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $6::BIGINT
  AND transcription_status = 'processing'
  AND transcription_attempt_id = $1::UUID
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM persisted_result)
RETURNING
    id,
    transcription_status,
    (SELECT id FROM persisted_result) AS enrichment_id,
    (SELECT outcome FROM persisted_result) AS outcome;

parameters.query:
/* provider_may_be_active must be false before terminalizing an initial attempt. */
WITH failed_attempt AS (
    UPDATE app.reel_enrichment_attempts
    SET
        status = 'failed',
        finished_at = NOW(),
        error_code = $2,
        error_stage = $3,
        error_message = $4,
        retryable = $5::BOOLEAN
    WHERE attempt_id = $1::UUID
      AND status = 'processing'
      AND $6::BOOLEAN = FALSE
      AND $2::TEXT = ANY (ARRAY[
          'INVALID_REQUEST',
          'OBJECT_NOT_FOUND',
          'OBJECT_ACCESS_DENIED',
          'OBJECT_READ_FAILED',
          'INTEGRITY_MISMATCH',
          'PROBE_FAILED',
          'AUDIO_EXTRACTION_FAILED',
          'STT_BATCH_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED',
          'STT_BATCH_OBJECT_CONFLICT',
          'STT_BATCH_UNSUPPORTED_DURATION'
      ]::TEXT[])
    RETURNING attempt_id, reel_id, status, error_code, error_stage, retryable
)
UPDATE app.reels AS reel
SET
    transcription_status = 'failed',
    transcription_attempt_id = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
FROM failed_attempt
WHERE reel.id = failed_attempt.reel_id
  AND reel.transcription_status = 'processing'
  AND reel.transcription_attempt_id = failed_attempt.attempt_id
RETURNING
    failed_attempt.attempt_id,
    failed_attempt.status,
    failed_attempt.error_code,
    failed_attempt.error_stage,
    failed_attempt.retryable,
    reel.transcription_status;

WITH active_attempt AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT attempt.attempt_id, attempt.provider_request_id
    FROM app.reel_enrichment_attempts AS attempt
    JOIN app.reels AS reel ON reel.id = attempt.reel_id
    WHERE attempt.attempt_id = $1::UUID
      AND attempt.reel_id = $2::BIGINT
      AND attempt.source_object_key = $3::TEXT
      AND attempt.expected_sha256 = $4::TEXT
      AND attempt.expected_size_bytes = $5::BIGINT
      AND attempt.pipeline_version = $6::TEXT
      AND attempt.contract_version = $7::TEXT
      AND attempt.status = 'processing'
      AND reel.id = $2::BIGINT
      AND reel.transcription_status = 'processing'
      AND reel.transcription_attempt_id = $1::UUID
    FOR UPDATE
), written_lro AS (
    UPDATE app.reel_enrichment_attempts AS attempt
    SET enricher_version = $8::TEXT,
        stt_provider = 'google',
        stt_model = 'chirp_3',
        provider_request_id = $9::TEXT
    FROM active_attempt
    WHERE attempt.attempt_id = active_attempt.attempt_id
      AND active_attempt.provider_request_id IS NULL
    RETURNING attempt.attempt_id, attempt.provider_request_id
), accepted_existing_lro AS (
    SELECT active_attempt.attempt_id, active_attempt.provider_request_id
    FROM active_attempt
    WHERE active_attempt.provider_request_id = $9::TEXT
)
SELECT * FROM written_lro
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM accepted_existing_lro;

WITH consumer_lock AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(308030::BIGINT) AS acquired
), processing AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT attempt.attempt_id, attempt.reel_id, reel.shortcode,
           attempt.source_object_key, attempt.expected_sha256,
           attempt.expected_size_bytes, attempt.pipeline_version,
           attempt.contract_version, attempt.language_hint,
           attempt.provider_request_id
    FROM app.reel_enrichment_attempts AS attempt
    JOIN app.reels AS reel ON reel.id = attempt.reel_id
    WHERE attempt.status = 'processing'
      AND reel.transcription_status = 'processing'
      AND reel.transcription_attempt_id = attempt.attempt_id
    ORDER BY attempt.started_at ASC, attempt.attempt_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CASE
    WHEN NOT consumer_lock.acquired THEN 'BUSY'
    WHEN processing.attempt_id IS NULL THEN 'CLAIM'
    WHEN processing.provider_request_id IS NULL THEN 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED'
    ELSE 'RECONCILE'
END AS flow_state,
processing.*
FROM consumer_lock
LEFT JOIN processing ON TRUE;

WITH failed_attempt AS (
    UPDATE app.reel_enrichment_attempts AS attempt
    SET status = 'failed', finished_at = NOW(), error_code = $9::TEXT,
        error_stage = $10::TEXT, error_message = $11::TEXT, retryable = FALSE
    WHERE attempt.attempt_id = $1::UUID
      AND attempt.provider_request_id = $2::TEXT
      AND attempt.reel_id = $3::BIGINT
      AND attempt.source_object_key = $4::TEXT
      AND attempt.expected_sha256 = $5::TEXT
      AND attempt.expected_size_bytes = $6::BIGINT
      AND attempt.pipeline_version = $7::TEXT
      AND attempt.contract_version = $8::TEXT
      AND attempt.status = 'processing'
    RETURNING attempt.attempt_id, attempt.reel_id
)
UPDATE app.reels AS reel
SET transcription_status = 'failed', transcription_attempt_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
FROM failed_attempt
WHERE reel.id = failed_attempt.reel_id
  AND reel.transcription_status = 'processing'
  AND reel.transcription_attempt_id = failed_attempt.attempt_id
RETURNING failed_attempt.attempt_id;

WITH consumer_lock AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* MGB030_TRANSCRIPTION_CLAIM_LOCK_KEY = 308030 */
    SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(308030::BIGINT) AS acquired
), locked_predecessor AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        predecessor.attempt_id AS predecessor_attempt_id,
        predecessor.reel_id,
        predecessor.source_object_key,
        predecessor.expected_sha256,
        predecessor.expected_size_bytes,
        predecessor.pipeline_version,
        predecessor.contract_version,
        predecessor.language_hint,
        reel.shortcode
    FROM app.reel_enrichment_attempts AS predecessor
    JOIN app.reels AS reel ON reel.id = predecessor.reel_id
    CROSS JOIN consumer_lock
    WHERE consumer_lock.acquired
      AND predecessor.attempt_id = $2::UUID
      AND predecessor.reel_id = $3::BIGINT
      AND predecessor.source_object_key = reel.object_key
      AND predecessor.expected_sha256 = reel.sha256
      AND predecessor.expected_size_bytes = reel.file_size_bytes
      AND predecessor.pipeline_version = $4::TEXT
      AND predecessor.contract_version = $5::TEXT
      AND predecessor.status = 'failed'
      AND predecessor.error_code = ANY (ARRAY[
          'STT_BATCH_PROVIDER_FAILED',
          'INVALID_REQUEST',
          'OBJECT_NOT_FOUND',
          'OBJECT_ACCESS_DENIED',
          'OBJECT_READ_FAILED',
          'INTEGRITY_MISMATCH',
          'PROBE_FAILED',
          'AUDIO_EXTRACTION_FAILED',
          'STT_BATCH_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED',
          'STT_BATCH_OBJECT_CONFLICT'
      ]::TEXT[])
      AND reel.transcription_status = 'failed'
      AND reel.transcription_attempt_id IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM app.reels AS processing_reel
          WHERE processing_reel.transcription_status = 'processing'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM app.reel_enrichments AS enrichment
          WHERE enrichment.reel_id = predecessor.reel_id
            AND enrichment.source_object_key = predecessor.source_object_key
            AND enrichment.source_sha256 = predecessor.expected_sha256
            AND enrichment.pipeline_version = predecessor.pipeline_version
      )
    FOR UPDATE OF predecessor, reel
), activated_reel AS (
    UPDATE app.reels AS reel
    SET
        transcription_status = 'processing',
        transcription_attempt_id = $1::UUID,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM locked_predecessor
    WHERE reel.id = locked_predecessor.reel_id
      AND reel.transcription_status = 'failed'
      AND reel.transcription_attempt_id IS NULL
    RETURNING
        reel.id AS reel_id,
        locked_predecessor.predecessor_attempt_id,
        locked_predecessor.shortcode,
        locked_predecessor.source_object_key,
        locked_predecessor.expected_sha256,
        locked_predecessor.expected_size_bytes,
        locked_predecessor.pipeline_version,
        locked_predecessor.contract_version,
        locked_predecessor.language_hint
), created_attempt AS (
    INSERT INTO app.reel_enrichment_attempts (
        attempt_id, reel_id, source_object_key, expected_sha256,
        expected_size_bytes, pipeline_version, contract_version, language_hint,
        retry_of_attempt_id, status, started_at
    )
    SELECT
        $1::UUID,
        activated_reel.reel_id,
        activated_reel.source_object_key,
        activated_reel.expected_sha256,
        activated_reel.expected_size_bytes,
        activated_reel.pipeline_version,
        activated_reel.contract_version,
        activated_reel.language_hint,
        activated_reel.predecessor_attempt_id,
        'processing',
        NOW()
    FROM activated_reel
    RETURNING
        attempt_id, reel_id, source_object_key, expected_sha256,
        expected_size_bytes, pipeline_version, contract_version, language_hint, retry_of_attempt_id
)
SELECT created_attempt.*, activated_reel.shortcode
FROM created_attempt
JOIN activated_reel ON activated_reel.reel_id = created_attempt.reel_id;
